subject: Decision: workbench pilot scope
body:
Team,

Decisions for the final stretch:

1. Yusuf's validation passed -- GPT2-xl conclusions reproduce under his parallel-block decomposition -- so the 7B port is greenlit as the workbench backend. That was the make-or-break and you handled it rigorously.
2. Pilot scope: the workbench ships to the assistant-model team first, with attention-knockout tracing and attribute-rate dashboards. Patching-based interventions stay expert-only for now; too easy to misread.
3. Maren confirmed the evaluation-data refresh landed June 24, so the pilot runs on refreshed prompts.

Pilot review July 3 as planned. If the assistant team's debugging time on their top-10 hallucination bugs drops measurably, that is our Q3 OKR story.

Priya
